{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows early signs of bearishness (e.g., sentiment < 0.33).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if last 5-7 days show upward momentum, apply a 10-15% upward bias correction.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias if forecast is significantly below 30-day moving average of true outcomes — especially after prolonged downward drift.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes — if true outcome exceeds forecast by >10%, cap next period’s forecast at +5% above prior.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., >0.50) and price is trending upward, increase forecast by 5-8% to capture momentum.",
    "If sentiment is neutral (0.00-0.33) and price is consolidating, apply a 2-5% downward bias to avoid overconfidence.",
    "For long-term horizons (>15 days), reduce forecast volatility — apply smoothing factor of 0.8 to previous forecast if sentiment is weak or mixed."
  ]
}
